body:
#307 D1 closes old dispatches and prepares a new six-target candidate after the host CLI fix. The old candidate15/v25 execution stays BLOCKED_PREWINDOW_REVIEW and its heartbeat stays PAUSED; its authorization, failure evidence, budgets and pins are retained.

The fixed host CLI resolves `--group` through `Host.group` before `archive_root` or `revoke_case`. Candidate16/v26 uses a new execution `aa2605a5-1fcf-4e9d-b6f2-8f5b13321b8a`, new disabled identities, independent restore resources and budgets, and a proposed 2026-10-20 18:00–18:40 Singapore window (read-only recovery ends 20:40). It covers P2→T1→T2→H2A→M1A→M1B; P1 stays excluded and all 11 survivors stay protected.

Validation: Python normal/-O each 34 methods; Go 274 PASS / 2 explicit SKIP. Actual three-source Core fingerprints and ACLs remain unchanged; 17 versions, 23 known IAM identities plus 9 absent names, 9 new backups and independent clean/rehearsal/native restores pass. Four business rehearsals preserve the 20 old fact multisets. The frozen offline validator and complete read-only entry pass; the latter records 113 technical request pairs and closes its owners. Technical helper requests and rehearsal CostEvents are recorded separately; amount remains NOT_ASSESSED.

The source commit `5472a583f86838df42a5ffd86bc366c166036efb` has exact-head PR CI run 39356719557, 13/13 success. Final publication-head CI and the bounded independent review are recorded separately. This is PR CI, not main CI or runtime acceptance.

The full confirmation and finite runbook are `docs/acceptance/issue307-d1-candidate16-confirmation.md` and `docs/acceptance/issue307-d1-v26-window-runbook.md`; results and remaining NOT_RUN items are in `docs/acceptance/issue307-d1-v26-preparation.md`.

The publication snapshot was NOT_AUTHORIZED. A new direct human approval by reference was recorded on 2026-10-20T06:02:11.933Z for candidate16/v26 execution aa2605a5-1fcf-4e9d-b6f2-8f5b13321b8a and only the fixed Singapore 18:00–18:40 window. All 76 referenced artifacts match. Post-authorization read-only Host.check passed with 994 allowed read-only processes, 30 false permissions and 3 empty new budgets. Its initial missing historical candidate13 checker failure is retained; the file was restored only from an existing byte-identical frozen copy, without rebuilding or changing the candidate. The disappearance cause remains undetermined. No new schedule exists pending the separate human scheduling instruction required by the frozen runbook; no source, enable, sender or wire was started, and zero DELETEs were issued. Window-local fresh checks remain required. #332 remains Draft and unmerged; #307 remains OPEN. Full D1 acceptance is NOT_ACCEPTED.
